overview.title: What is KHAAD BHARAT BIOCHAR?
overview.intro: KHAAD BHARAT Biochar is a high-stability, carbon-rich soil amendment designed to rejuvenate depleting agricultural lands.
points: Natural Biochar: Made from carefully sorted agricultural residue, kitchen waste, and organic materials.
Controlled Process: Thermally processed under oxygen-limited conditions to retain maximum porous structure.
Soil Enhancement: Modifies physical soil structure to hold vital nutrients right where root systems develop.
Sustainable Farming: Helps rebuild the topsoil layer organically, reducing dependency on chemical inputs.

biocharExplanation.title: How BIO CHAR Works in the Soil
biocharExplanation.subtitle: The science behind long-term soil productivity
biocharExplanation.text: Biochar has an incredibly high surface area and porous structure at the microscopic level. This acts as a physical sponge, capturing water molecules and locking in nutrients that would otherwise wash away during irrigation or rain. It also provides a safe habitat for beneficial microbes, promoting natural soil health.

waterSaving.title: How BIO CHAR Helps Save Water
waterSaving.subtitle: Combat drought, lower bills, and protect crops
waterSaving.desc1: By blending KHAAD BHARAT Biochar into the root zone, the soil holds moisture for much longer periods. This decreases the frequency of tube-well watering, saving valuable ground water.
waterSaving.desc2: Fewer watering cycles mean lower electricity bills for tube-well pumps and reduced diesel costs for generator-operated motors, increasing the farmer's net profit.

soilHealth.title: Rejuvenating Soil Health from the Roots
soilHealth.subtitle: Visualizing the underground shift in soil structure
soilHealth.text: Repeated chemical use compacts the soil and kills natural microbes. Adding Biochar creates aeration channels, neutralizes acidic pH levels, and creates a stable habitat for helpful organisms.
soilHealth.spongeEffectDesc: Biochar pores house water permanently in root zones.

usageGuide.title: How to Use BIO CHAR
usageGuide.subtitle: Simple steps for maximum field impact

steps.title: Prepare Field
steps.desc: Plough the soil well and clear any weeds before sowing or transplanting.

steps.title: Mix with Compost
steps.desc: Blend Biochar with organic compost or cow dung (1:4 ratio) for optimal nutrient charging.

steps.title: Apply near Root Zone
steps.desc: Apply the mixture directly near the crop roots or sow it along the seed lines.

steps.title: Irrigate Properly
steps.desc: Give a thorough watering immediately after application to activate the pores.

steps.title: Monitor & Save
steps.desc: Observe moisture retention and gradually reduce your watering frequency.

applicationSteps.title: Product Application Timeline & Guidance
applicationSteps.subtitle: Dosage guides and seasonal recommendations
applicationSteps.dosageText: Apply 2-3 tons per acre for open fields, or 10-15% by volume in nursery and garden soils.
applicationSteps.cropAIText: Get dynamic, real-time dosage calculations tailored to your exact crop and soil type. Our model is preparing for AI crop recommendations.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to common queries about BIO CHAR

items.a: BIO CHAR is a highly stable carbon-rich material produced by heating organic waste under low oxygen conditions. It acts as a permanent soil enhancer.
Its highly porous structure acts like a microscopic sponge, holding water and releasing it slowly to the roots as the soil dries.
Yes! KHAAD BHARAT Biochar is 100% natural, made from agricultural and organic biomass waste without chemical additives.
It can be used for all crops including wheat, rice, vegetables, fruits, sugarcane, and also in nurseries, gardens, and farmhouses.

items.q: How long does it last in soil?
items.a: Unlike compost which decomposes in months, Biochar is highly stable and remains in the soil, providing benefits for decades.
Yes. Since it prevents nutrients from leaching or washing away, fertilizers stay in the soil longer, allowing you to reduce application rates.
